issues.description: Method acceptSupplyDelivery: the problem statement's UML declares this method as public (+acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int): void) while the reference implementation declares it without an access modifier (package-private) as "static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)". This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended API and may cause access problems if tests or examples expect a public method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation's method visibility match the UML: declare the method as public and static in SealSaloon (public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) { ... }). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to explicitly state that acceptSupplyDelivery is intentionally package-private if that is the intended design.
